subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “His friend Tina played fewer games but chose carefully.”?
options: At first, students thought it was a game.
On the first day, a teacher stood near the road and watched students cross safely.
She watched each game first and picked the ones she understood.
"That was the first movie your mother and I watched together," he said.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「At first, students thought it was a game.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「On the first day, a teacher stood near the road and watched students cross safely.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「His friend Tina played fewer games but chose carefully. She watched each game first and picked the ones she understood.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「'That was the first movie your mother and I watched together,' he said.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
